rows.label: tlk70000029_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I did a bit of traveling
myself back in the day.
Saw a bit of the world.

rows.label: tlk70000029_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I've seen resource-rich countries and
cities prospering through their own
unique cultures, but...

rows.label: tlk70000029_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Still, nowhere compares to Iira. No
major wars, famines, or epidemics have
troubled us.

rows.label: tlk70000029_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Iirans live in peace and quiet thanks
to our wise and prudent king.

rows.label: tlk70000029_01_msg0005
tlk70000029_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Some criticize the king as weak for
becoming more moderate, but I think
he's a wonderful ruler!
